name: Sheila's Favourite Supper Dish
description: A layered casserole of chicken or pork chops, mushroom soup, and cheese, topped with Stove Top dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Place chicken or pork chops in the bottom of a pan.
Mix mushroom soup and milk. Pour over the meat.
Sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
Top with Stove Top dressing according to package directions.
Bake at 300°F for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

keywords: casserole, chicken or pork, mushroom soup, Stove Top dressing

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken Breast
_similar.description: A simple breaded chicken breast recipe.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash chicken breast.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and seasoning.
Dip in milk, then egg mixture, then bread crumbs.
Bake in a 9x13 inch pan at 350°F until golden.
Serve with rice or noodles.

_similar.name: Creamy Chicken Stew
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

_similar.keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken
